Generate VPC control streams and launch NONMEM runs

Source: R/nm_vpc_ctl.R
nm_vpc_ctl.Rd

From an estimation run, generates two NONMEM control streams required for a VPC:

  • <run>_orig.ctl: re-runs the model at MAXEVAL=0 with final estimates fixed, producing observed predictions (_orig.fit).

  • <run>_sim.ctl: simulates n_sim replicates using $SIMULATION ONLYSIM SUBPROBLEMS=n_sim, producing _sim.fit.

Both control streams are then launched via nm_run.

Usage

nm_vpc_ctl(
  run,
  analysis_dir = NULL,
  nmfe_path,
  n_sim = 500,
  seed = 12345,
  skip_terminated = TRUE,
  run_subdir = NULL,
  verbose = TRUE,
  n_cores = 1L,
  ...
)

Arguments

run

Path of the estimation run: its control stream ("C:/project/run001.ctl"), its run directory ("C:/project/run001.reg") or its stem ("C:/project/run001"). Its .ctl, .ext and .lst files are looked for in run001.reg/, run001.nm7/, run001/, then directly in the folder of the run (flat layout); this folder is the analysis directory, where the VPC control streams are written.

analysis_dir

Deprecated (former form run_name + analysis_dir): when given, run is read as the run name in this directory, with a warning.

nmfe_path

Full path to the nmfe executable (e.g. "C:/nm76g64/run/nmfe76.bat" on Windows, "/opt/nm760/run/nmfe76" on Linux or macOS).

n_sim

Number of simulation replicates (default: 500).

seed

Random seed for $SIMULATION (default: 12345).

skip_terminated

Passed to nm_run. If TRUE (default), already completed VPC runs are skipped.

run_subdir

Layout of the two VPC runs, passed to nm_run. By default (NULL) the layout of the estimation run is reused: "" (flat) if its files were found directly in the analysis directory, ".reg" otherwise.

verbose

Passed to nm_run and used locally for messages.

n_cores

Passed to nm_run: 2 runs the _orig and _sim control streams at the same time (default 1).

...

Former argument name, accepted with a warning until version 1.0: run_name (now run).

Value

A data.frame run log (from nm_run) with one row per VPC run (_orig and _sim).

Details

The $PK block of the source control stream must contain a line of the form NSIM = <value> which will be replaced by NSIM = 1 in _orig.ctl and NSIM = IREP in _sim.ctl.

Final parameter estimates are read from the .ext file of the estimation run (row -1000000000) and written as FIX values in both generated control streams.

The generated .ctl files are written to the analysis directory (not inside a run subdirectory). They can be inspected or edited before running if needed. Wings for NONMEM is not required.

See also

nm_run

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
log <- nm_vpc_ctl(
  run          = "C:/analyses/my_pk_project/run001.ctl",
  nmfe_path    = "C:/nm76g64/run/nmfe76.bat",
  n_sim        = 500,
  seed         = 12345
)
print(log)
# Then run the VPC:
# fig <- nm_vpc("C:/analyses/my_pk_project/run001.ctl")
} # }
